fields.reason: A timestamp bounding what is SENT to a model. It narrows egress only and can never widen it: messages before it stop being dispatched via all three reintroduction paths (recency window, rolling checkpoint, semantic recall). Nothing is deleted, nothing is hidden from the owner's own view, and no sensitivity verdict is overridden — the screen simply re-scores a smaller payload. Carries no personal or governed value itself.
